## 1. Dataset

```{r}
Retinopathy_Debrecen <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/ZahraPc/Downloads/archive (2)/Retinopathy_Debrecen.csv",
  header = TRUE
)
```
## 2. Dataset Structure and Variables

```{r}
str(Retinopathy_Debrecen)
names(Retinopathy_Debrecen)
head(Retinopathy_Debrecen, 15)
```
## 3. User-Defined Function

```{r}
retinopathy_status <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x == 1, "Signs Present", "No Signs")
}

Retinopathy_Debrecen$Status <- retinopathy_status(
  Retinopathy_Debrecen$class
)

table(Retinopathy_Debrecen$Status)
```



## 4. Filtering Data Using Logical Criteria

```{r}
retinopathy_filtered <- subset(
  Retinopathy_Debrecen,
  class == 1 & quality == 1
)

head(retinopathy_filtered)
nrow(retinopathy_filtered)

```

## 5. Dependent and Independent Variables

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

Retinopathy_Debrecen$ID <- seq_len(nrow(Retinopathy_Debrecen))

dependent <- Retinopathy_Debrecen %>%
  select(ID, class)

independent <- Retinopathy_Debrecen %>%
  select(ID, ma1, ma2, ma3)
independent_long <- pivot_longer(
  independent,
  cols = c(ma1, ma2, ma3),
  names_to = "Measurement",
  values_to = "Value"
)

independent_wide <- pivot_wider(
  independent_long,
  names_from = Measurement,
  values_from = Value
)

combined_data <- inner_join(
  dependent,
  independent_wide,
  by = "ID"
)

head(combined_data)


```

## 6. Removing Missing Values
```{r}
# Count missing values in each column
colSums(is.na(Retinopathy_Debrecen))

# Remove rows containing missing values
retinopathy_clean <- na.omit(Retinopathy_Debrecen)

# Compare rows before and after cleaning
nrow(Retinopathy_Debrecen)
nrow(retinopathy_clean)

```

## 7. Identifying and Removing Duplicate Data

```{r}
# Check duplicates using the original dataset columns
original_columns <- setdiff(
  names(retinopathy_clean), c("ID", "Status")
)

# Count duplicate records
sum(duplicated(retinopathy_clean[original_columns]))

# Remove duplicate records
retinopathy_clean <- retinopathy_clean[
  !duplicated(retinopathy_clean[original_columns]), ]

# Display remaining records
nrow(retinopathy_clean)
```

## 8. Reordering Rows in Descending Order

```{r}
# Sort retinal measurements in descending order
retinopathy_sorted <- retinopathy_clean %>%
  arrange(desc(ma1), desc(ma2))

# Display the first 10 sorted records
head(retinopathy_sorted, 10)
```


## 9. Renaming Column Names

```{r}
# Rename selected columns
retinopathy_clean <- retinopathy_clean %>%
  rename(
    Image_Quality = quality,
    Pre_Screening = pre_screening,
    Retinopathy_Outcome = class
  )

# Display updated column names
names(retinopathy_clean)
```


## 10. Adding New Variables Using Mathematical Functions

```{r}
# Create new variables using mathematical calculations
retinopathy_clean <- retinopathy_clean %>%
  mutate(
    ma1_Doubled = ma1 * 2,
    ma2_Average = (ma1 + ma2) / 2
  )

# Display the original and calculated variables
head(retinopathy_clean[, c("ma1", "ma2",
                           "ma1_Doubled", "ma2_Average")])

```

## 11. Creating a Training Set

```{r}
# Set a seed for reproducible random results
set.seed(123)

# Randomly select 70% of the records for training
train_index <- sample(
  seq_len(nrow(retinopathy_clean)),
  size = floor(0.7 * nrow(retinopathy_clean))
)

# Create training and testing datasets
train_set <- retinopathy_clean[train_index, ]
test_set <- retinopathy_clean[-train_index, ]

# Display dataset dimensions
dim(train_set)
dim(test_set)
```


## 12. Summary Statistics

```{r}
# Display summary statistics for the cleaned dataset
summary(retinopathy_clean)
```

## 13. Mean, Median, Mode and Range

```{r}
# Calculate mean and median
mean_ma1 <- mean(retinopathy_clean$ma1)
median_ma1 <- median(retinopathy_clean$ma1)

# Create a user-defined function to calculate mode
get_mode <- function(x) {
  values <- unique(x)
  values[which.max(tabulate(match(x, values)))]
}

# Calculate mode and range
mode_ma1 <- get_mode(retinopathy_clean$ma1)
range_ma1 <- range(retinopathy_clean$ma1)

# Display results
mean_ma1
median_ma1
mode_ma1
range_ma1
```


## 14. Scatter Plot: ma1 vs ma2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(retinopathy_clean, aes(x = ma1, y = ma2)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Retinal Measurements ma1 and ma2",
    x = "ma1 Retinal Measurement",
    y = "ma2 Retinal Measurement"
  )
```


## 15. Bar Plot: Diabetic Retinopathy Outcomes

```{r}
# Count records by retinopathy outcome
outcome_counts <- retinopathy_clean %>%
  group_by(Retinopathy_Outcome) %>%
  summarise(Count = n())

# Create a bar plot
ggplot(outcome_counts,
       aes(x = factor(Retinopathy_Outcome),
           y = Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Diabetic Retinopathy Outcomes",
    x = "Retinopathy Outcome (0 = No Signs, 1 = Signs Present)",
    y = "Number of Records"
  )
```



## 16. Pearson Correlation Between ma1 and ma2

```{r}
# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient
cor(retinopathy_clean$ma1,
    retinopathy_clean$ma2,
    method = "pearson")

# Perform Pearson correlation test
cor.test(retinopathy_clean$ma1,
         retinopathy_clean$ma2,
         method = "pearson")
```
